title: Jewelry Token Master
description: Jewelry Token Master — The Townstons wiki
html:
Jewelry Token Master

Gives yellow items in exchange for Kings Coins. There is a small chance that he will give purple items instead of yellow.

Items sold are immediately soulbound to the buyer.

As of Build 110, The Jewelry Token Master has been removed. Class specific jewelry can now be purchased from: the Fighter Equipment Token Master, Mage Equipment Token Master and Ranger Equipment Token Master.
